task: Compile a public-API-only acceptance consumer with catch-all recovery across multi-package dependencies.
observation: Native lowering failed with BUILD_BACKEND_ERROR because generated recovery variants referenced transitive csv__CsvError and binary__BinaryError types that were not linked when only the public wrapper modules were imported. Adding explicit direct csv and binary imports made the same checked consumers compile and execute; Fast Debug did not expose a comparable link boundary.
impact: The acceptance package and generated live oracle need otherwise-unused direct transitive imports, weakening the package abstraction and making source-backed acceptance setup depend on backend linkage details.
evidence: ../../margo build --json from sdk/advanced-data-acceptance (BUILD_BACKEND_ERROR: csv__CsvError not found)

UV_CACHE_DIR=$PWD/tmp/uv-cache TMPDIR=$PWD/tmp /home/owner/.local/bin/uv run --no-project --with cbor2==5.7.1 python sdk/advanced-data-acceptance/cbor2_oracle.py (BUILD_BACKEND_ERROR: binary__BinaryError not found before direct import)

resolution.summary: Declare the transitive provider as a direct package dependency and import its module so native recovery lowering links the error type.

suggestion: Link transitive raised-error metadata automatically or emit a Moss-level diagnostic naming the direct import currently required by native lowering.
